item.title: Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport, killing at least five
item.dc:creator: France 24
item.description: At least five people were killed and five injured after an Amazon cargo plane overshot the runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday and crashed into several vehicles, officials said. Miami Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz said there was “no apparent threat to public safety” following the crash.
